implementation: Validate the documented version/Installer/setup.exe registration layout before deriving a Windows install target. Preserve existing fallback semantics, case-insensitive names and registry/setup version skew.

testRegistration.bindings: Existing native ProductState, base::win::RegKey, RegistryOverrideManager and real temporary directories. No fake host, service, store or Model::OpenItem.

acceptance.criterion: Use authorized signing/release infrastructure and verify package signatures.
acceptance.required: Owner-approved signing/release ownership and expected signer identity, approved package format/scope, actual artifact and installed-binary OS trust verification.

acceptance.criterion: Test clean install, default-browser registration, upgrade and retained Profile data.
acceptance.required: Native Windows prerequisite and approved distinct identity, real Windows clean install/default-browser/upgrade tests and retained Profile/workspace evidence after schema/durability prerequisites.

acceptance.criterion: Keep rollback/downgrade behavior explicit and surface update/security failures without bypassing OS trust.
acceptance.required: Owner rollback/downgrade and data disposition decisions, schema compatibility contract and real failure/restart/security UX checks.

ownerDecisionsNeeded: Supported Windows package format and per-user/per-machine installation scope.
Fork-owned Windows application identity and registration namespace, including applicable product paths, ProgIDs, AppUserModelID, protocols and service/COM identifiers.
Authorized release/signing infrastructure and expected publisher/signing identity with credential custody.
Rollback/downgrade compatibility and retained-data disposition, including uninstall/cleanup choices.

commands.note: Installer utility work needs no new browser command. Reserved 40797 is unused; no ActionItem mapping or IDS strings are introduced.
